dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Two distinct high-contrast white horizontal bands; the superior band is shorter and thicker, while the inferior band is longer with sharp grayscale boundaries.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence; sharp, linear pale edges visible along the length of the folded primary and secondary feathers.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white outer vane on the outermost tail feather (rectrix).
